notes: *at the time of* is a rule 67 complex frame and rides undivided with the expressed ἐπί, which is the token that would carry the plain case preposition; it is not `added`, rule 11 making the ASV's markup evidence rather than a verdict.

The frame carries its own determiner, so τῆς still takes its own *the* under rules 19 and 21. The head on the prepositional word follows the 2 Corinthians run; rule 67's divided case leaves a head on *time* defensible, as the note records.
